# E0243: a published schema was changed

Once a lineage is published, its schemas are fixed: a new revision may only add
versions. This revision changes a schema that was published, so instances
validated against the published one may no longer be instances of it.

## Example

`old.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: string
			}
		}
	}
}
```

`new.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: int
			}
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0243]: schema 0.0 differs from the published one
   --> new.cue:5:4
    |
  5 |             schema: {
    |             ^^^^^^
    |
    = note: in thema's own CUE
     --> thema/lineage.cue:178:11
    = detail: field a not present in {a:int}
              missing field "a"
    = help: a published schema is never changed; add a new version instead
```
